summary: OUR rows 27-43 are the Dark Tournament's opening run and they adapt act.52-76 of the manga contiguously, with no skipped source material anywhere in the block — the boat preliminaries and the first opponents (52-53), Team Rokuyukai (54-60), the day off and Team Ichigaki (61-65), and the Team Masho quarter-final (66-76). Both bracketing anchors HOLD: ep 26 → 52 [51] dovetails with ep 27's START at 52 (second half), and the fence ep 44 → 78 [77] is confirmed three ways (fandom ep-44 field '77-78'; the Dark Tournament Saga page's semi-final block 'Manga Chapters 77-87, Anime Episodes 44-50'; ja-WP ep 44's subtitle 幻海からの最大の試練 namesaking act.77 最大の試練!!) — no fence repair needed, only a candidate MEDIUM→high promotion. All 17 target rows are canon and all 17 take an anchor; no anchor_hostile row. The block's pace is ~1.5 ch/ep and six rows stop mid-chapter, so six C1/C2 continue points are delivered (28→55, 30→58, 34→63, 38→69, 40→72, 42→75). Two rows carry sliver edges handled under this series' own stored precedents: ep 27 cold-closes on the FIRST PAGE of act 54 (END stays 53 — the ep-1 shape, ep 28 re-covers 54 from its start) and ep 36 opens on the re-shown end of act 64 and closes on the opening scene of act 66 (START 65 / END 65 — the ep-52 '(end only)' shape, ep 37 re-covers 66). Surprise finding: our volume table has no rows for v6-v9, and the fandom chapter pages give them exactly (v6 46-55, v7 56-63, v8 64-72, v9 73-81) — reported in structure.

anchors.note: Boat preliminaries + the hotel-room visit by Rinku and Zeru = act 53 最初の敵!! 'The First Opponents!!'; the fandom field adds '54 (first page)' but ep 28 re-covers act 54 from its start, so END stays 53 (A4 + the stored ep-1 precedent: '{1, 2 (p.1-2)}' → END 1). START 52 dovetails with the stored ep 26 → 52 [51] {51, 52 (first half)} and its continue 52/parity (A10). Saga page: 'The Departure to Hanging Neck Island (Manga Chapters 51-53, Anime Episodes 26-27)'.

Kuwabara vs Rinku. act 54 先鋒戦開始!! 'The Vanguard Battle Begins!!' namesakes the English title 'First Fight'; the episode's JP subtitle 小さな強敵!鈴駒の秘技 namesakes act 55 秘技・魔妖妖!! ('The Secret of Devil Yo-yos'), which it enters and leaves mid-chapter (ends on Rinku's 'Around the World' lift). A4/A10; saga block 'Round One … Manga Chapters 54-60, Anime Episodes 28-32'.

Kurama vs Roto, ending on the Death Seed blooming = act 56 血染めの花!! 'Blood-Stained Flowers!!', which the JP episode subtitle 血の花を咲かす蔵馬! namesakes exactly. Picks up act 55's second half (A10). First row of volume 7 (56 opens v7 per the fandom chapter pages).

Hiei vs Zeru = act 57 恐怖の炎熱地獄!! 'The Fearsome Hell of Blazing Heat!!'; the episode ends with Chu entering the ring and the drunken-fist match starting, i.e. the first half of act 58 酔拳士・酎!! 'Drunken Master: Chu!!' (A4). Inside the saga's Round One block 54-60 / eps 28-32.

Yusuke vs Chu; the JP subtitle よいどれ戦士!酎の酔拳 namesakes act 58 酔拳士・酎!!, and the episode closes on Chu's proposal to settle it — the end of act 59 互角の勝負!! 'A Close Game!!' (A4). Continues inside act 58 from ep 30 (A10).

One chapter to a full episode. The JP episode subtitle ナイフエッジデスマッチ IS act 60's title ナイフエッジ・デスマッチ (en 'Knife-Edge Sudden Death!!'), and the English title 'Knife Edge Death-Match' matches too; the round-one block ends at 60 with ep 32 (saga page). A4.

The rest day, Toguro's one-man match and the top-eight bracket = act 61 ベスト8出そろう!! 'The Top Eight Line-Up!!'; the JP episode subtitle 激突!ベスト8出そろう carries the chapter title verbatim. Opens the saga's Round Two block (61-65 / eps 33-36). A4.

Round two vs Team Ichigaki begins = act 62 2回戦開始!! 'The Second Round Begins!!'; the episode ends inside act 63 卑劣!操血瘤!! on the flashback to Ichigaki's deal with the three fighters. The 62/63 split rests on the fandom field plus adjacency with ep 35's START at 63 (second half) — MEDIUM (A4/A10).

The mask is torn (JP 覆面の正体?!美しき戦士 / en 'Glimpse Beneath the Mask') and Kuwabara is beaten out of the ring while realising the fighters are screaming 'KILL US' — act 64 目を覚ませ!! 'Open Your Eyes!!' (A4). First row of volume 8 (64 opens v8 per the fandom chapter pages; en-WP labels this chapter 065, see structure).

The Spirit Wave, Ichigaki's transformation and defeat = act 65 1対3!! 'One vs. Three!!'; the saga page closes Round Two at chapter 65 with this episode. The leading '64 (end only)' is the re-shown tail of the chapter anchored to ep 35, so START is counted at 65 (the stored ep-52 '{89 (end only), 90-91}' → START 90 precedent, A10); the closing '66 (start only)' is the single scene of Team Masho walking in, which ep 37 re-covers, so END stays 65 (the stored ep-1 precedent). MEDIUM: both edges are unquantified in the source.

The quarter-final against Team Masho opens = act 66 魔性使いT登場!! (the JP episode subtitle 闇の忍・魔性使いチーム carries 魔性使い), and ja-WP's 相違点 section cites act.66「魔性使いT登場!!の巻」 against this very episode's Ruka scene — a direct, independent act-number citation. Ends with Gama's body-art fight = act 67 化粧使い・画魔!! ('Master of Disguise'). Saga block: quarter-finals 66-76 / eps 37-43. A4.

Kurama, sealed by Gama's dying makeup, beats the ice master Touya = act 68 呪氷使い・凍矢!! 'Toya: Ice Master!!'; the episode ends with Bakken hauling the unconscious Kurama up — the first half of act 69 ひとりきりの闘い 'A Battle All Alone', which the English title 'Kurama's Stand' echoes. A4/A10.

Yusuke destroys Bakken for what he did to Kurama = act 70 一閃!怒りの拳!! 'Fist of Rage!!', which the JP episode subtitle 粉砕!幽助怒りの鉄拳 namesakes; the episode closes with the Yusuke-vs-Jin bout just started (the end of act 70). Continues inside act 69 from ep 38 (A10).

The aerial fight with Jin = act 71 やばいカケ!! 'A Dangerous Gamble!!'; the episode ends with Yusuke dropping into Genkai's Spirit Wave stance, i.e. inside act 72 霊丸を越えろ!! 'Surpass the Reigun!!' (the chapter Shueisha used as volume 8's title 霊丸を超えろ!!の巻). A4/A10.

The Spirit Wave finishes Jin and the decision is reversed = act 73 意外な敗北!? 'An Unexpected Defeat?!', which the JP subtitle 霊光弾!意外な決着?! namesakes; ends with Risho vs Kuwabara set. First row of volume 9 (73 opens v9). A4/A10.

Kuwabara's last-ditch win over Risho = act 74 瀬戸際の闘い!! 'The Eleventh Hour!!'; the closing Yusuke/Keiko scene runs into act 75 霊界獣出現!! 'The Underworld Beast!!', whose subject (Puu about to hatch) opens ep 43 — so the END is a mid-chapter stop in 75. A4/A10.

Puu hatches and the Masked Fighter is revealed as Genkai = act 76 覆面の下の素顔 'The Face Under the Mask', which the JP subtitle 覆面戦士の厳しき素顔 namesakes; the saga page ends the quarter-final block at chapter 76 with this episode, and ep 44 opens the next block at 77. Last row before the stored fence. A4/A10.

annotations.note: Cold-close on the first page of act 54; ep 28 re-covers 54 from its start, so END stays 53 — the same shape as the stored eps-1 annotation ('2 (p.1-2)').

Cold-open re-covers only the ending of act 64 (already anchored to ep 35) and the final scene shows only the opening of act 66 (Team Masho's entrance), which ep 37 re-covers — START counted at 65 (the stored ep-52 precedent), END at 65 (the stored ep-1 precedent).

~1.5 chapters per episode across the block: most rows open and/or close mid-chapter, so the anchors sit at the fandom page splits and six rows carry an in-chapter continue point (eps 28, 30, 34, 38, 40, 42).

One chapter padded to a full episode. ja-WP 原作とアニメの主な相違点 (citing this episode): the Knife-Edge Death Match is brokered through Sakyo in the anime, plus an added Rinku/Chu slum-meeting flashback, Karasu's route into Team Toguro, and the first Shizuru-Sakyo meeting — none in act 60.

One chapter padded to a full episode. ja-WP (citing this episode): Karasu and Elder Toguro stand at ringside for Toguro's one-man match, and Team Makai Kyosenshi gets anime-only member names including the original character Ragubi — additions inside act 61.

ja-WP (citing eps 37 and 41): Ruka appears as a nurse and her barrier actively damages Hiei and the Masked Fighter inside it — an expansion of act 66's setup — and ep 41 adds her binding ropes peeling away as Hiei's demon energy returns. No manga content displaced.
ja-WP (citing eps 42 and 43): the Sakyo/Shizuru lighter scene (ep 42) and Genkai baiting Yusuke out before handing over the Spirit Orb (ep 43) are anime additions to acts 74-76.

repairs.old: A Master of Love and Death
repairs.new: A Matter of Love and Death
repairs.why: Cosmetic title typo in our row. en-WP 'Yu Yu Hakusho season 2' (ep 42, 1993-08-07) and both fandom pages (Episode_42 infobox and the Season 2 episode guide) read 'A Matter of Love and Death'. The date and position are unaffected — the join in this verdict was made on date + JP subtitle (決死の桑原!愛の突撃), not on the English string (R20).

structure.notes: ROW IDENTITY (R20): our rows 26-46 carry the same numbers, English titles and Japanese air dates as en-WP 'Yu Yu Hakusho season 2', the fandom Season 2 episode guide and ja-WP's 各話リスト (27 = 1993-04-24 死の船出!地獄の島へ … 43 = 1993-08-14 覆面戦士の厳しき素顔 … 44 = 1993-08-21 幻海からの最大の試練). The N11 drop[113] (Picture Drama) is trailing and does not touch this range; no index joins were used. Only deviation: our ep-42 title reads 'Master' where every source reads 'Matter' (repair proposed); our ep 36 'A Trial of Light' matches fandom while en-WP writes 'A Trial by Light' — left alone. CHAPTER SPACE: our numbers are the JP act numbering (ja-WP: 暗黒武術会編 = act.52-112; ja-WP cites act.052「暗黒武術会開幕!!の巻」 and act.066「魔性使いT登場!!の巻」, both matching the fandom chapter pages). The en-WP 'List of YuYu Hakusho chapters' list SKIPS the number 064 (vol 7 ends 063, vol 8 opens 065), so from volume 8 onward its labels run +1 against act numbering — en-WP 065 'Open Your Eyes!!' = act 64, en-WP 080 'Hiei Fights Again!!' = act 79 (already recorded in the stored batch-17 note), en-WP 083 = act 82. Every chapter number in this verdict is in ACT space. A separate, unrelated +1 exists in the Viz English edition (en-WP footnote: Viz mislabels act 18 as a second chapter 17). VOLUME BOUNDARIES: our table has no rows for volumes 6-9; the fandom chapter pages give them exactly and they agree with the shifted en-WP list — v6 = 46-55, v7 = 56-63, v8 = 64-72, v9 = 73-81 (v10 = 82-91 already stored). Shueisha's volume subtitles corroborate: vol 7 = ナイフエッジ･デスマッチの巻 (act 60), vol 8 = 霊丸を超えろ!!の巻 (act 72, the last chapter of v8), vol 9 = 最大の試練!!の巻 (act 77). FENCE: both bracketing anchors hold unchanged — ep 26 → 52 [51] and ep 44 → 78 [77]; the latter, stored MEDIUM, is now corroborated by the fandom ep-44 field (77-78), the saga page's semi-final block (chapters 77-87 / episodes 44-50) and the ja-WP subtitle namesake of act 77, and is a candidate for promotion to high without any value change. NO SKIPS: acts 52-76 are covered contiguously by rows 27-43, so no C2/C3 skip-parity continue is needed anywhere in the block; the six continue points are all C1 mid-chapter straddles. AFG could not be used — animefillerguide.com serves its table via JavaScript and the fetched HTML contains no chapter column (it is cross-check only under the ask in any case).

flags_for_sean: SOFTEST EDGE, eps 35/36: the fandom fields read ep 35 = '63 (second half)-64' and ep 36 = '64 (end only)-65-66 (start only)'. I read '(end only)' as the stored ep-52 shape (a re-shown cold open → START counted at the next chapter, 65). The alternative reading — that ep 36 first-animates the tail of act 64 — would make ep 36's START 64 and would add a continue at 64 to ep 35. Both readings leave the ENDs (35 → 64, 36 → 65), the saga block (61-65 / eps 33-36) and the fence untouched; ep 36 is filed MEDIUM for this reason. https://yuyuhakusho.fandom.com/api.php?action=parse&page=Episode_35&prop=wikitext&format=json | https://yuyuhakusho.fandom.com/api.php?action=parse&page=Episode_36&prop=wikitext&format=json

SLIVER CALLS: ep 27 ('54 (first page)') and ep 36 ('66 (start only)') are both trailing fragments that the NEXT episode re-covers from the chapter's start, so I kept END at 53 and 65 under this series' own stored ep-1 ruling rather than promoting the number under 'pages, not numbers' — those pages are re-shown in ep 28 / ep 37, not first-time-only. If you prefer the opposite default here, ep 27 → 54 and ep 36 → 66 are the alternatives and neither breaks the fence.
FENCE PROMOTION CANDIDATE: ep 44 → 78 [77] is stored MEDIUM ('mid-Dark Tournament clean boundary'); three independent sources now agree on it. Value unchanged — only the confidence.

VOLUME TABLE GAP: our volume_boundaries have nothing below v10. v6 = 46-55, v7 = 56-63, v8 = 64-72, v9 = 73-81 are confirmed by the fandom chapter pages (volume field on Chapter_50 … Chapter_82) plus the shifted en-WP list; worth an ingest of the missing rows so the v6-v9 anchors in this verdict display a volume from the table rather than from the anchor row alone.
